Bhairavastava · v1 · PASS

Veneration

Abhinavagupta · 10-verse stotra · studio chant available
bhairavanātham anāthaśaraṇyaṃ tvanmayacittatayā hṛdi vande
Bhairava-Lord, refuge of the helpless — by mind become Yours, in heart I venerate. The stotra opens with the devotee's stance: total surrender of mind to Bhairava.
Pushing · GEM
"The devotee's doing is NOTICING. The affliction comes to mind; the noticing of it IS the vimarśa — and the vimarśa IS what produces the nectar."
